notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Major visual and UI update.

The ugly hexagon stage was replaced for a traditional room with wood trim and a more classic wallpaper. The visual customization was removed in favor of a clean design that has a more 'magazine' look.

A toy train was added because trains are fun.

The UI was changed from grip selection of game modes and settings to a laser pointer. This was in order to simplify game selection with clear buttons having large text. The selection options also changed from displaying many game modes to what is now one game mode with multiple difficulties depending on the amount of boards playing with.

Alternate game modes are now selected through the 'custom' option in the main menu.

The height of the boards can now be changed in the settings tab for players of varying height and is saved.
